pages.title: Sand Color Loop
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Sand Color Loop is a conveyor-belt puzzle in which you place buckets to catch colored sand and carry it to the correct destination. Watch how the sand piles up, slides, and spills, then time your bucket placements around the moving belt. You need to leave gaps between buckets while keeping different colors from mixing or spilling.

Obstacles and increasingly difficult levels add to the challenge. Each placement calls for attention to both the sand's movement and the belt's rhythm, so planning the spacing of your buckets matters as much as reacting at the right moment.

pages.title: Car Wash Simulator
pages.creator: splitch games
pages.description:
Car Wash Simulator is a business game about cleaning vehicles and expanding a car wash. Use pressure washers, foam, and detailing equipment to handle dirty cars, then put earnings and tips back into the operation. Better tools help develop the service as the business grows.

Expansion includes adding wash bays and hiring staff. Optional video rewards can provide a helper, replenish soap, or cover an upgrade. Balance the immediate cleaning work with purchases that increase what your car wash can handle, gradually turning a small operation into a larger business.

pages.title: Drag Shift: Street Race
pages.creator: RBIN
pages.description: Drag Shift: Street Race focuses on the launch and gear changes of a drag race. Hold the revs in the green zone, shift at the right moment and activate nitro from second gear onward. Beat rivals to earn cash for tuning and new cars.

pages.title: Brain Jam
pages.creator: FInal work
pages.description: Brain Jam asks you to free a red car from a crowded parking lot. Drag the other vehicles along their lanes to open an exit on the right. Try the daily puzzle or use a hint when the next useful move is difficult to find.

pages.title: Miner: drilling
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Miner: Drilling sends you into mines where pushing against a block starts the drill automatically. Break ore for money and choose how far to continue each descent. Buy upgrades for the miner and mines to prepare for the next run.

pages.title: Summer Triple Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Summer Triple Mahjong asks you to collect three identical summer-themed tiles at a time. Select only tiles with a free left or right side and clear the layout before the timer expires. Use a hint when the remaining matches become difficult to locate.

pages.title: Mahjong build farm
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Mahjong Build Farm combines three-tile matching with developing a farm. Find identical pictures and gather them into triplets to clear each board. Complete the levels and use the resulting progress to turn the starting hill into a growing farm.

pages.title: Dessert DIY
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Dessert DIY puts you in a food studio preparing sweets to match customer requests. Follow the recipe steps, choose ingredients and assemble the dessert. Earn coins from satisfied customers and spend them on additional items and improvements in the shop.

pages.title: Ragdoll Jump
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Ragdoll Jump sends a stickman upward through a building escape. Tap and swipe to guide the jumping character, collect helpful items and avoid traps that cause a fall. Keep the movement under control while approaching the goal.

pages.title: Word search
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Word Search hides words on a chosen topic inside a letter grid. Drag from the first letter to the last to highlight a word horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Remember that words can overlap as you search for the full set.

pages.title: Blade Forge 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Blade Forge 3D lets you make a sword before testing it against an opponent's weapon. Select a mold, forge and temper the blade, then polish it to improve its damage value. Complete the workshop steps to prepare for the comparison.

pages.title: Sniper Shot Secret Mission
pages.creator: PlayNode
pages.description: Sniper Shot Secret Mission asks you to identify and shoot a specific target in each situation. Study the scene before firing, since a wrong shot fails the mission and the first bullet alerts nearby guards. Choose a clear opportunity before the target escapes.

pages.title: Planet Merge
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Planet Merge drops celestial bodies into a merging puzzle. Position a planet, release it and bring matching bodies together to create a new one. Consider where each drop will settle so the next merge remains possible.

pages.title: Landmine Cube
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Landmine Cube puts you in control of a rolling cube collecting every jewel in a level. Use its warning glow to judge when a mine is nearby and choose another route. Hitting mines costs lives, and losing them all restarts the stage.

pages.title: Reversi
pages.creator: Atomirex Technologies
pages.description: Reversi challenges you to finish with more disks of your color than the computer. Place a disk to bracket opposing pieces and flip them to your side. Choose a difficulty level and think about the positions each move leaves available.

pages.title: Banana Bounce!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Banana Bounce! follows a banana moving through a side-scrolling run. Drag to control the character, collect coins and use power-ups to extend the attempt. Unlock other characters and upgrade the bonuses that help you travel farther.

pages.title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Solitaire Farm Seasons 3 combines card-clearing puzzles with farm development. Play a card one rank higher or lower than the discard pile, drawing from the spare stack when necessary. Between boards, plant and harvest crops, earn coins and improve the farmhouse.

pages.title: Put the fruit together!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Put the Fruit Together! asks you to drop fruits into a shared play area and combine identical ones. Each merge creates a larger fruit as you work toward a watermelon. Plan the landing positions to keep making combinations and increase your score.

pages.title: Energy Clicker
pages.creator: Barsuk Studio
pages.description: Energy Clicker makes a pedal-powered generator your way of lighting a city. Keep pressing to produce electricity, but watch the permitted energy level. Pushing beyond that limit damages the generator, so balance output with keeping the equipment running.

pages.title: Traffic Run Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Traffic Run Puzzle combines a car-merging business with intersection driving. Buy cars and merge them into more valuable vehicles, then take a car onto the road. Time its movement through the traffic so it reaches the other side without a collision.

pages.title: Police Car Real Cop Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Police Car Real Cop Simulator gives you police assignments involving driving, parking, pursuits and stopping violators. Explore the roads in a patrol vehicle and complete the task shown for the current mission. Leave or enter the car when an assignment requires it.

pages.title: Dog Puzzle Story 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Dog Puzzle Story 3 joins Charlie the puppy for winter-themed matching boards. Line up at least three toys, treats or pillows to clear them and let new pieces fall into place. Follow the objectives shown beside the board to complete each stage.

pages.title: Find the Anemacilus
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Find the Anemacilus sends you searching unusual landscapes for hidden magical artifacts. Inspect rocks, bushes and other scenery to locate the full set before time expires. Use the available tips when a remaining object is difficult to distinguish.

pages.title: Black Hole Attack
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Black Hole Attack gives you a limited time to swallow weapons with a moving hole. Collect enough equipment to provide ammunition for the boss fight that follows. Improve features such as the hole's width or timer to prepare for another attempt.

pages.title: Save My Pumpkin
pages.creator: Orosula Games
pages.description: Save My Pumpkin asks you to draw a barrier around a pumpkin threatened by bats. Make a line that blocks the attackers and protects the pumpkin for ten seconds. Consider the gaps around your drawing before the danger begins.

pages.title: Super Huggie Bros
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Huggie Bros sends you across islands filled with platforms, monsters and hidden keys. Run and jump past obstacles, collect coins and break blocks to uncover the items that open gates. Reach the next area while working toward the treasure.

pages.title: Money Honey
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Money Honey turns outfit shopping into a collecting run. Move left or right to choose characters and opportunities that provide different amounts of money. Build the funds needed for clothing items such as bags, shoes, skirts and trousers along the route.

pages.title: Electric Racer
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Electric Racer puts a customizable car on neon-lit streets for a night drive. Accelerate, steer and brake with the keyboard while exploring the road layout. Try different turns and speeds as you practice handling the chosen vehicle.

pages.title: Ball Giant Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Ball Giant Rush asks you to roll into balls that share your color to grow larger. Steer away from differently colored balls, since contact makes you shrink and can end the attempt. Choose a route that keeps adding size instead of losing it.

pages.title: Cooking Tile
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Cooking Tile is a matching puzzle with a temporary display bar. Tap tiles on the board to send them into the bar, where three identical pieces disappear together. Choose the order to keep useful matches available as you clear the arrangement.

pages.title: One Line Draw
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: One Line Draw asks you to extend an animal's body through a defined area in one continuous stroke. Plan how the shape will fit before drawing the route. Work through the levels with cats and other animal characters.

pages.title: Bumper Ball io
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Bumper Ball IO puts rolling competitors on a stage where the goal is to knock rivals over the edge. Defeating an opponent changes your ball's size. Use that growing presence while protecting your own position and trying to be the last competitor remaining.

pages.title: Space killers (Retro edition)
pages.creator: Airem
pages.description: Space Killers Retro Edition puts a spaceship against aliens invading the solar system. Move with the arrow keys and fire with Space to fight the attacking craft. Keep the ship out of danger while destroying enemies for points.

pages.title: Panda commander
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Panda Commander sends a panda pilot into aerial battles against enemy forces and bosses. Move the plane around incoming threats and keep attacking the opposing aircraft. Upgrade the plane and its weapons to prepare for harder encounters.

pages.title: Ninja Dogs
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Ninja Dogs makes a cannon your way of launching ninja dogs at the Black Cat's forces. Adjust the shot's angle and power, then activate the dog's special attack while it is airborne. Break through the defenses to recover the scroll and rescue the master.

pages.title: Building Rush 2
pages.creator: Barbarian Games
pages.description: Building Rush 2 puts you in charge of factories supplying a town under construction. Produce building materials, sell them and earn medals for your performance. Spend upgrade points on productivity improvements, or replay a level to aim for a better result.

pages.title: Princess Christmas Places
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Christmas Places helps Mia and Ava prepare for a Christmas celebration. Choose festive outfits and accessories, then pick a suitable place for the occasion. Coordinate the characters and surroundings to complete their holiday plans.

pages.title: Slendrina X The Dark Hospital
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Slendrina X The Dark Hospital traps you in an abandoned hospital with five days to escape. Search for useful objects and hiding places while keeping quiet around the pursuing threat. Interact with the surroundings and work toward a route out.

pages.title: Green Circles
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Green Circles puts a ball inside rotating circles with narrow openings and sharp spikes. Time the jumps to pass through the gaps without hitting the interior hazards. Adjust the jump height as the circles continue turning around you.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 4
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Kingdom of Ninja 4 sends a ninja through twenty platform stages filled with enemies and dangerous balls. Move with the arrow keys and jump with Z to negotiate the route. Watch the space ahead before advancing past the next monster.

pages.title: Bullet Rush Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bullet Rush Online sends you down corridors crowded with enemies. Move to aim and shoot while staying outside the reach of opponents trying to grab you. Reach the level's goal safely and improve the score along the way.

pages.title: Mahjong Jungle World
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Mahjong Jungle World is a timed tile-pairing game with jungle pictures. Remove identical tiles that have a free left or right side, opening more of the board as you go. Use hints when needed and clear the layout before time expires.

pages.title: Break The Wall 2021
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Break the Wall 2021 asks you to run a character through walls standing in the way. Use the up arrow or a mouse click to control the action. Keep breaking through the obstacles as the run continues.

pages.title: Dunk Jumps
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Dunk Jumps sends a ball between two walls lined with spikes. Tap to jump toward a safe landing and gather stars for extra points. Check the hazards around a star before chasing it, since touching a spike ends the run.

pages.title: Car Park Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Car Park Puzzle challenges you to create an exit through a packed parking area. Move the surrounding vehicles to open a route for your car. Work through the layouts and use a hint when the next useful move is unclear.

pages.title: Shortcut Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Shortcut Run gives you a race where collected bricks can become bridges across the water. Gather enough material and choose where to leave the normal route for a shortcut. Keep the bridge supplied so the runner does not fall into the lake.

pages.title: Hole vs Bombs
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Hole vs Bombs asks you to swallow every block on a level with a movable hole. Guide it underneath the targets while leaving bombs untouched. Later arrangements mix hazards among the blocks, making a careful collection route more useful than rushing.

pages.title: Sisters Halloween Face Paint
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Sisters Halloween Face Paint lets you create seasonal looks for two sisters. Choose spooky face-paint designs, then coordinate Halloween clothing and accessories. Finish both makeovers with combinations that suit the celebration.

pages.title: Car Simulation Game
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Car Simulation Game gives you nine cars and a choice of road or off-road driving areas. Watch for traffic, since collisions reduce your energy and can force a restart. Use the keyboard to steer, brake and activate nitro while trying to extend the drive.

pages.title: Anime Kawaii Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Anime Kawaii Dress Up offers six dolls and a wardrobe inspired by Japanese street fashion. Combine everyday clothing, fantasy pieces and colorful accessories to shape each look. Explore the different styles while customizing the characters individually.

pages.title: Word Cross Jungle
pages.creator: ArcadeGears
pages.description: Word Cross Jungle turns word finding into a crossword-style puzzle. Work out the words needed for the current layout and complete the remaining spaces. Use the letters and answers already uncovered to help identify the next entry.

pages.title: Knock Balls
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Knock Balls brings physics-based target knocking to a carnival-style shooting puzzle. Aim and launch balls at the arrangement in front of you. Look for a hit that brings down more of the structure rather than leaving awkward targets standing.

pages.title: Roller Coaster Fun Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Roller Coaster Fun Hidden asks you to locate concealed stars within amusement-ride pictures. Examine the scene and select the hidden shapes before the timer expires. Search the smaller details around the rides to find the remaining targets.

pages.title: Highway Rider Motorcycle Racer Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Highway Rider Motorcycle Racer Game sends a motorcycle through traffic at increasing speed. Dodge cars and trucks while using boosts to extend the ride and build your score. Keep watching for gaps before moving past the next vehicle.

pages.title: Garbage Truck Simulator
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Garbage Truck Simulator puts you on a city rubbish-collection route. Drive to the waiting waste, load the truck and deliver the rubbish to the processing site. Complete the cleanup tasks while controlling the large vehicle through the streets.

pages.title: Metro Train Simulator Game
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Metro Train Simulator Game puts you in charge of an orange-line passenger train. Drive between stations and transport the people waiting along the route. Follow the displayed instructions to handle the current service and complete the assigned mission.

pages.title: Friendly Dragons Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Friendly Dragons Coloring offers eight dragon pictures and a palette of 23 colors. Fill the different parts of a drawing to create your own finished version. Work quickly for the scoring challenge, or save the colored picture when it is ready.

pages.title: Big Luggage Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Big Luggage Trucks Match 3 asks you to line up at least three same-colored pieces to score. Keep forming combinations while watching the meter on the left. If that supply falls too low, the current run comes to an end.

pages.title: Easter Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Easter Differences challenges you to locate changes between paired Easter pictures before time expires. Click each detail that differs and try to finish quickly for a better score. Use the hint button when one remaining change is difficult to find.

pages.title: Medical Staff Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Medical Staff Puzzle turns six pictures of medical workers into jigsaws. Select a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece arrangement and reconnect the scattered sections. Use recognizable faces, uniforms and background edges to restore the chosen image.

pages.title: Honey Drop
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Honey Drop is a timing game about dropping honey from a bee into a basket. Watch their positions and tap when the honey has a clear path to the container. A missed drop costs a life, so judge the release carefully.

pages.title: Backflip Maniac
pages.creator: GameFlare.com
pages.description: Backflip Maniac asks you to land a backflip inside a red target square. Begin with lower jumps and adjust the rotation before attempting taller buildings. A landing outside the marked area does not advance the level.

pages.title: Zombie Tornado
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Zombie Tornado puts you among the undead with survivors to rescue. Move between threats, shoot approaching zombies and pick up health or weapons when the route is clear. Keep resisting the attacks while trying to bring more people to safety.

pages.title: 4x4 drive offroad
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: 4x4 Drive Offroad puts trucks on rough routes for transport challenges. Steer across the terrain and handle the cargo-driving tasks while exploring the available vehicles. Unlock additional trucks and features as you continue working through the driving game.

pages.title: Onet Zombie Connect 2 Puzzles Mania
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Onet Zombie Connect 2 Puzzles Mania is a tile-linking puzzle with zombie-themed pictures. Select matching pairs that can be joined along a clear route and remove them from the board. Open useful space for the tiles that remain and use hints when necessary.

pages.title: Skull Racer
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Skull Racer gives you a monster car to drive over hurdles toward a destination. Gather coins while negotiating the uneven course and keep the vehicle moving past each obstacle. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to complete the route.

pages.title: Hit Shooty Clocks
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Hit Shooty Clocks turns clocks into targets for a shooting challenge. Use the mouse to fire and work toward destroying every clock. Watch the next target before committing to a shot so you can complete the arrangement.

pages.title: Santa Delivery
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Santa Delivery makes Santa's sleigh route a planning puzzle. Drag a path that collects Christmas gifts and brings them to the correct homes around town. Think through the delivery order before setting out, using a hint if the route becomes difficult.

pages.title: Xtreme Rolly Vortex
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Xtreme Rolly Vortex asks you to control a rolling ball through an obstacle-filled route. Move left or right to find a gap and collect rubies along the way. Keep the ball clear of hazards while working toward the goal.

pages.title: Cooking Fast 3 Ribs And Pancakes
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Cooking Fast 3 Ribs and Pancakes puts you behind a busy kitchen counter. Select ingredients to cook, prepare the requested dish and serve the waiting customer. Upgrade equipment to help with the rush, or discard an unwanted plate with a double click.

pages.title: Happy Green Earth
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Happy Green Earth is a drawing puzzle about bringing water back to a thirsty planet. Draw lines that guide the flow toward Earth. Consider how the water will travel along your barriers before completing the route.

pages.title: Word Cube
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Word Cube asks you to select letters from cubes to complete a required word. Tap the cubes in the appropriate order and check how the spelling fits the prompt. Finish the word to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Crazy Pong 2
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Crazy Pong 2 challenges you to keep a ball inside a circular playing area. Move left or right to meet its path before it escapes the boundary. Build a higher score and spend the earnings on new appearances.

pages.title: KnifeBlades.io
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: KnifeBlades.io surrounds your character with collectible knives for arena battles. Hold and drag to move and attack, or release to enter a defensive mode. Gather more blades and choose when to advance on an opponent or protect your position.

pages.title: Blaze Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Blaze Trucks Jigsaw gives you twelve pictures from Blaze and the Monster Machines to rebuild. Fit each scattered piece into the correct position and complete the selected image. Try to recognize the trucks and scenery quickly to improve your assembly time.

pages.title: Crazy Fishing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Crazy Fishing sends a hook into the water to collect fish for points. Guide the fishing attempt through the available catches and bring the rewards back. Improve the hook, speed or reachable depth to develop the next fishing trip.

pages.title: Warrior And Coins
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Warrior and Coins is a running challenge with coins to collect along a scrolling route. Jump or double-jump to clear the obstacles and keep the warrior alive. Continue farther as the game's speed increases and more hazards approach.

pages.title: School Fun
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: School Fun asks you to find the letters shown in the upper-right corner. Search the picture and select the indicated characters to unlock the next level. There is no timer, so you can examine the scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Basketball Street
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Basketball Street gives you a limited supply of basketballs to turn into points. Judge each shot's path and send the ball toward the basket. Make the available attempts count while trying to improve the final score.

pages.title: Jump Ball Arcade
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Jump Ball Arcade challenges you to keep a ball moving while avoiding spikes. Time the jumps around the hazards and try to increase the score before a collision ends the attempt. Watch the next landing area before making another move.

pages.title: Cooking Scene
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Cooking Scene puts you in a kitchen serving customer orders against a busy pace. Prepare the requested food and serve it quickly to earn coins. Spend those earnings on better tools as you work through the levels.

pages.title: College Girls New Dress
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: College Girls New Dress helps a group of friends prepare outfits for a new college day. Browse the available clothing and coordinate a look for each girl. Compare the pieces before choosing the finished styles.

pages.title: Puzzle Ball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Puzzle Ball asks you to slide blocks into a connected route for a ball. Move the correct pieces until the path reaches the goal without a break. Use the hint system when the arrangement makes the next transfer difficult to see.

pages.title: Tanks master
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description: Tanks Master puts your tank against enemy vehicles and incoming shots. Fire back to destroy the attackers while protecting the tank's remaining lives. Collect diamonds and keep fighting to improve the score recorded for the run.

pages.title: Archerry
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Archerry turns a cherry above a partner's head into an archery target. Aim at the fruit and judge the shot carefully before releasing the arrow. Keep the trajectory clear of the character standing underneath it.

pages.title: Star Ripper
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Star Ripper follows a prisoner escaping through a space station. Run down corridors, break boxes for bonuses and reach portals to continue to the next level. Collect a protective suit to help survive the dangers along the way.

pages.title: Cyclops Ruins
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Cyclops Ruins puts a hero beneath falling debris while confronting a giant cyclops. Move around the arena to collect coins, bonuses and power-ups. Keep clear of the falling objects, since each hit takes energy from the hero.

pages.title: Superlady Movie
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Superlady Movie prepares Wonder Woman for three different scenes. Choose a warrior outfit for the action sequence, a look for a date and appropriate clothing for a job interview. Explore the wardrobe to match the character's appearance to each situation.

pages.title: Trumpoline
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Trumpoline is a cartoon political parody about bouncing toward the White House. Guide Donald Trump past opposing characters and keep the movement going. Time the next bounce to stay clear of the obstacles along the route.

pages.title: Polar Fishing
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Polar Fishing asks you to stack ice blocks before a polar bear smashes through them to free trapped fish. Time the placements to build a useful tower, then watch the breaking phase. Spend rewards on upgrades that improve later attempts.

pages.title: Ladybug And Elsa Xmas Selfie
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ladybug and Elsa Xmas Selfie lets you prepare two friends for a Christmas photograph. Choose tops, bottoms and hairstyles for Ladybug and Elsa, coordinating an outfit for each. Finish both holiday looks before their selfie together.

pages.title: Rosalie Winter Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Rosalie Winter Day helps Rosalie dress for cold weather before meeting her friends. Combine a blouse and trousers with a jacket, hat and winter boots. Change item colors and add a purse to complete the outfit.

pages.title: Princess Ballerina Bullet Rush
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Ballerina Bullet Rush begins with a ballerina searching her room for missing belongings before a performance. Find the hidden items, then select a costume, accessories and shoes. Get everything ready so she can take her place on stage.
